summary.text: Brad Christ is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 96 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Brad Christ was born in St. Louis, Missouri, and earned a bachelor's degree from DePaul University in 2006.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Shrewsbury as the youngest of four children, attended Affton Public Schools, and went on to SLUH for high school before DePaul University in Chicago.
